about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of seeing neighbours overcharged by cowboys.
about_para_1: Noble Plumbing and Heating was founded in 2009 with one aim: honest, fast plumbing and heating work at fair prices. We're based in Markyate, St Albans, and we've built our reputation on turning up on time, diagnosing faults correctly, and getting the job done right. Our team is Gas Safe registered and fully qualified — every member carries the skills to handle emergencies and complex installations.
about_para_2: Over 15 years we've earned the trust of thousands of Hertfordshire families and landlords. You'll find us on weekday mornings, Saturday afternoons, and 24 hours a day when disaster strikes. We don't charge call-out fees, we quote upfront, and we stand behind our work with guarantees. If you choose us once, you'll likely choose us again — most of our work now comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals.
reviews_heading: What St Albans Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Woke up to water pouring through the kitchen ceiling on a Sunday morning. Called Noble at 8am and a plumber arrived by 9:30. He diagnosed a burst pipe upstairs, fixed it, and mopped up all the mess. Charged a fair price and no faffing about. Absolute lifesaver.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Our boiler broke down in November during half term with four kids at home. Noble came out the next morning, fitted a new condensing boiler, and we saved £40 a month on heating bills. The engineer explained everything clearly and the job was finished by evening. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: I'm a landlord with two properties in the area. Noble service both annually and they're always professional, punctual, and thorough. I trust them completely to look after my tenants' safety. Gas Safe paperwork is sorted without me chasing them. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Nigel K.
